title: Kamishiro Rui — Runaway Thought Process〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: What's on your mind? Exciting Picnic!

rows.Line: Hiking Trail

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The park knows about the sign back there now, so all that's left to do is...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I think we're finally getting a break from the rain. We should probably head down before it starts up again.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But those two girls back there...
I swear I've seen them before...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which two girls?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh! I remember now!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Airi Momoi and Shizuku Hinomori!
They're both idols, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Idols?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I've seen them on TV before.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, are they famous?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I guess you wouldn't know, Rui. You've never been interested in music shows or celebrity news and stuff...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You have me there... Oh, would you look at that...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Finally, found you! E-Excuse me!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank you for helping us out back there! You really saved us!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You came all this way to tell us that?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. We wanted to thank you sooner, but were still pretty flustered about what just happened.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thank you very much for what you did.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, um... We just happened to be passing by and...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
And that led to you saving us.
We can't thank you enough!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-You're welcome...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Th-They really are idols...
It's like they actually have this sort of shine or sparkle to them...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But what about Mizuki...?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(After we saved everyone,
Mizuki looked ecstatic...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(But I sensed it before at school...
Maybe something is wrong...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We should get back soon. I think we've made the other people on this tour wait long enough already.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (That may've been a mistake...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Staring at Mizuki like that probably triggered a few alarm bells. I may not be able to ask what's the matter now...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, we'll be heading off now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Bye bye♪
Later, Rui...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I'll see you at school.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui? Is something about Akiyama bothering you...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, no. It's nothing.
Why do you ask?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Why? Because you had this really serious expression on your face just now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Mizuki's smile just now... Maybe it wasn't an act. What if it was for me...?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Look at us. You're worried about me while I'm worried about Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You are? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm not sure. That's partly what concerns me...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You've known Akiyama since junior high, right...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Are you sure you don't want to go and say something?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I'm sure. I'd be causing the rest of the group trouble, and I can just try asking about it at school.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, if you say so...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I appreciate your concern, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Shall we head home now?
